setup_guide.introduction: Try the public synthetic EMC-2 matter from GitHub to see a draft finding alongside its sources. For your own matter, choose an authorized folder and the question you want the review to answer.

sample.title: EMC-2 investigation sample
sample.description: Download and review the pinned public EMC-2 synthetic matter from GitHub. The sample includes a review question.
sample.expected_output: A draft with linked source passages, competing explanations and a question for counsel.

values.inputs.payload.goal: Investigate financially relevant events and competing explanations in the synthetic EMC-2 materials. Cite the evidence and state limitations.

real.introduction: Choose an authorized document folder and the question you want the draft to address.

fields.label: Legal documents folder
fields.description: Choose the folder you are authorized to review. Use Start from sample data for the public synthetic EMC-2 case.

fields.label: What question should this review help you answer?
fields.description: Name the disputed event or decision to support. Include a date range or transaction reference if useful. I will test competing explanations; your question is review direction, not evidence.

fields.label: Counsel matter intake
fields.description: Optional matter.json for claim or defense elements, exclusions, cited transactions and private privilege-log metadata. Add in Configure before starting.

fields.label: Review scope
fields.description: Adaptive review follows gaps and conflicting evidence for up to three rounds. First pass runs once. Standard review also uses the configured relationship extraction.

fields.label: Review objective
fields.description: Choose the work the investigation should prepare for counsel.

fields.label: Output folder
fields.description: An additional copy of the review draft and audit files is saved here.

fields.label: Previous review decisions
fields.description: Carry forward reviewed facts, witness questions, discovery tasks and saved graph questions from this matter. Use the review-decisions.json exported by the previous report.

fields.label: Saved explanation preferences
fields.description: Managed in Memory. Changes Chat wording only; domain work and approvals keep their existing controls.

run_guidance.on_start: I’ll index the selected documents so the draft can link each finding to its sources and show conflicting evidence.
run_guidance.web_ui_ready: Open Full report to ask the case graph a question, follow the cited passages and check gaps in the proof chart.
run_guidance.report_ready: Expand the run summary and read Your next review to see which question needs counsel’s attention.
run_guidance.output_ready: Open final_report.md in the output folder and start with the next review question for counsel.

starter_questions: Can I try the public synthetic EMC-2 case?
Which documents and review scope do you need?
What supports this finding, and what contradicts it?

web_ui.description: Optional offline source-linked investigation, published after citation verification.

registration.writes: static-html web_ui.json handle in the run output
